My Dear Love 💕

From the very first moment I saw you, I knew you were different — the kind of person who makes ordinary days feel like something out of a dream.

You are my calm in every chaos, my favourite song on the worst days, and the reason I smile at random moments for no reason at all.

I built this little website just to tell you — you are incredibly loved. Not just on special occasions, but every ordinary Tuesday, every tired evening, every ordinary breath.

Thank you for being mine. Thank you for choosing me, again and again, without a second thought. I promise to keep being someone worthy of that love. 🌹

— Yours, forever 💑
